_note: One family table, read by both classifiers (brief 9.19a). server.py's
model_profile and lora_profile resolve family and variant through these
rows and nothing else: adding a model family is adding a row, never a
new elif, and the two classifiers can no longer drift. Kept beside
catalog.json so it stays next to the installer's own notion of what a
family is.
Resolution order, most trustworthy first: the sidecar's declared
baseModel, then the by-hash record (9.19b fills server.BY_HASH_BASE_MODEL;
a mapping, not a fetch), then the safetensors header's own training
metadata (modelspec.architecture / ss_base_model_version / base_model /
lora_base_model), and only then the folder hint. Nobody downloading from
CivitAI inherits our folder layout. Rows are precedence-ordered: the
first row whose hints claim a file wins.
Row shape:
id                the family string recipes declare in RECIPE_SPECS
base_model        substrings matched against the lowered declared base
path_prefix       rel-path prefixes (backslash-terminated folders)
path_contains     substrings matched anywhere in the lowered rel path
path_contains_all token groups; every token in a group must appear
variant           fixed variant - a string, or per consumer
variants          ordered variant rules, first match wins: shared
base_model substrings plus per-consumer hint keys
(model_path_prefix/model_path_contains/
lora_path_contains)
variant_default   fallback variant per consumer
source_only       reachable from a finished frame, never offered by
the composer as a text-to-image choice

families.note: Ordered before the qwen rows: Anima ships beside a Qwen text encoder and VAE, and a name-based fall-through would file it as qwen_image.
Qwen-Image-Edit only ever runs as the image editor. Ordered before qwen_image so an edit build never falls through to the text-to-image line.

FLUX.2 Klein: one unified model - text-to-image from the composer (klein_t2i) AND whole-frame, masked and reference edits from a finished frame. It was source_only until 2026-09-03 only because Pixal had no t2i graph for it, never because the model lacked one.
